title: Drawable Funding Held Back Against a Micro Market Reopening
content:
Where a suspension request stands approved on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement over the trailing year, part or all of the funding still drawable is held back against the reopening rather than set against the cover need, and how many funding lots the agreement has carried settles how much.

## The clause

1. Where the agreement carries at or above 2 funding lots, and a suspension request stands approved over the twelve months to the day the lot is worked out, half of the funding still drawable is set against the cover need, taken to the nearest cent and a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent, the rest being held back against the reopening.
2. Where the agreement carries below 2 funding lots, and a suspension request stands approved over those twelve months, none of the funding still drawable is set against the cover need.
3. Where no suspension request stands approved over those twelve months, no such holding back is made.

## The boundary

The repeat funding count is 2 subsidy funding lots on the agreement, counted over the whole life of the agreement: exactly 2 meets it, 1 does not. Either line turns on a single approved suspension request standing over the twelve months to the day the lot is worked out.

*Hypothetical.* An agreement carrying 4 funding lots with an approved suspension request over the trailing year, and 2320.00 USD of funding still drawable, sets 1160.00 USD against the cover need. An agreement carrying a single funding lot with that same suspension request sets none of the 2320.00 USD against it.
